lineas.texto: Welcome, deputy. I am José Mariano Mendizábal, secretary of this Assembly.
Marshal Sucre summoned the deputies of the five provinces of Upper Peru by a decree of 9 February.
The decree named Oruro, but we are meeting here, in Chuquisaca. Before you go in, tell me: where do you think we should have met?
Take the Declaration to the deputies. President Serrano will sign last.
Leave the Declaration on the Secretariat's table, by the wall.
The Great Hall is at the far end of the courtyard. It was the Jesuits' chapel and today it is the University's main hall.
This Assembly has not yet decided whether we join Peru, Argentina, or become independent.
I argue for union with Peru. Take this brief with my reasons and think it over before you vote.
Listen to every side before you vote, deputy.
The fate of these provinces is still undecided: Peru, Argentina or independence.
I argue for union with the Provinces of the Río de la Plata. Here is my brief.
From this gallery you can see the whole courtyard. Go back to the hall when it is time to vote.
I am Casimiro Olañeta. In this Assembly I defend the cause of independence.
Take this brief and compare it with the others. Let your vote be a considered one.
I am Mariano Serrano, president of this Assembly. The time has come to vote.
Before you vote, listen to the deputies of each position.
The Declaration is signed. Deliver it to the Secretariat.
The Assembly is still in session, deputy.

d_sede.pregunta: Where should the Assembly have met?
d_sede.contexto: The decree of 9 February named Oruro. Some deputies asked for another seat.

opciones.texto: In Oruro, as the decree said
opciones.reaccion: Mendizábal notes your opinion. The Assembly, however, convened in Chuquisaca.
Mendizábal nods: this is where the Assembly finally convened.

d_destino.pregunta: Which path should Upper Peru take?
d_destino.contexto: You heard the three positions and you have their briefs. Your vote is recorded in the minutes of the session.

opciones.reaccion: Your vote is recorded, but the Assembly took another path.

opciones.texto: Join the Provinces of the Río de la Plata
opciones.reaccion: Your vote is recorded, but the Assembly took another path.
Your vote matches what the Assembly decided.

d_nombre.pregunta: What name should the new republic bear?
d_nombre.contexto: The Assembly must give the new State a name.

opciones.reaccion: That was the name the Assembly adopted.
That name came later. The sources disagree on who proposed it and when.
The Assembly chose another name: República Bolívar.

cierre.texto: The Assembly decided on independence and founded the República Bolívar. From then until 1898, Congress met in this very hall.
